news_codex_ratings.json.review_mode: Scheduled cloud dual-review; independent Codex desk
limitations: Confidence values are subjective evidence confidence, not return probabilities. News remains unweighted in the trading score.
The latest committed raw feed was fresh at review time and the Wednesday PSX session was live under the repository calendar. EXCHANGE_HOLIDAYS is empty and SESSION_OVERRIDES is empty.

The new Business Recorder IMF-review item was materially relevant as Pakistan macro context, but the linked article body was not accessible in this cloud session. The assessment therefore uses only the committed headline and snippet and is explicitly labelled headline/snippet evidence.

No new company-specific or configured-sector cash-flow evidence was identified in the fresh additions. Current-session upstream oil and Oil Marketing ratings are carried forward unchanged; an unreviewed story is not a Neutral rating.

reviewed_stories.title: Pakistan and IMF begin next EFF and RSF review talks
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Broad Pakistan macro process milestone only. The accessible evidence does not establish a direct or configured-sector cash-flow link for a tracked PSX name.
reviewed_stories.reason: The IMF mission has started discussions with Pakistani authorities for the next EFF and RSF review. The committed headline and snippet do not report a staff-level agreement, disbursement decision, missed benchmark, new condition, or policy change, so the start of talks alone does not justify changing a tracked stock or sector rating.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: The committed raw feed records September 23, 2026 at 13:51:28 PKT. The linked Business Recorder page was inaccessible in this cloud session, so the timestamp and evidence remain headline/snippet-level rather than page-verified.

OGDC.reason: Brent fell to $98.16 as Saudi Arabia restored a major bypass pipeline, Saudi and Iraqi export availability improved, and US crude inventories rose. Those developments weaken the crude-price tailwind for an upstream producer. Regional conflict risk remains, so confidence stays moderate.
OGDC.relevance: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration; OGDC is a PSX-listed hydrocarbon producer.

PPL.reason: Brent fell to $98.16 as Saudi Arabia restored a major bypass pipeline, Saudi and Iraqi export availability improved, and US crude inventories rose. Those developments weaken the crude-price tailwind for an upstream producer. Regional conflict risk remains, so confidence stays moderate.
PPL.relevance: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration; PPL is a PSX-listed hydrocarbon producer.

MARI.reason: Brent fell to $98.16 as Gulf supply availability improved. That is negative for the oil-linked part of MARI's hydrocarbon exposure, but MARI is not a pure crude-price proxy, so the company-level inference is weaker than for OGDC and PPL.
MARI.relevance: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration; MARI is a PSX-listed hydrocarbon producer.

Oil Marketing.reason: The fresh ex-depot price reset lowers petrol by Rs1.70 per litre and HSD by Rs3.12, but the article provides no evidence that OMC margin economics changed and does not quantify inventory or demand effects.
Oil Marketing.relevance: Sector link: Oil Marketing, including PSO.
